name: @dsh-plugin-wsl-env/probes
description: Gives test/probe modules their own package identity. Without it, the nearest manifest is this checkout's package.json, which declares dsh.client, so the client-modules roster treats a probe Loader row as a second source of dsh-plugin-wsl-env — the wslfs profile links the plugin from the Windows mirror, and composition fails with 'resolves from multiple active Loader sources'.
